oral_examination.oral_examination: *48 The cheek is swollen, the mouth opening is II, and there is anteroposterior impaction. The distal blind pocket is red and swollen. A small amount of pus can be seen flowing out of the periodontal pocket. *48 Orthotopic impaction is palpable.

treatment_plan.definitive: *48 Rinse to reduce inflammation and remove after acute inflammation subsides
treatment_plan.notes: It is forbidden to eat foods with pigments within two days, and instructions on how to brush teeth will be provided, and any discomfort will be followed up.

source_handle: *48 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Rinse alternately with saline and chlorhexidine, and apply iodine and glycerin.
